description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Http Authentication Client Object, including processing requests/responses, generating digests, managing authentication info, and internal state management.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoProcessRequest
methods.description: Processes an HTTP request for authentication purposes.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoProcessResponse
methods.description: Processes an HTTP response related to authentication.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoGenerateDigestResponse
methods.description: Generates a digest response for HTTP authentication.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoGenerateCNonce
methods.description: Generates a client nonce for authentication.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoGetNC
methods.description: Returns the nonce count for authentication.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoAddAuthInfo
methods.description: Adds authentication information based on a challenge.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoFindAuthInfo
methods.description: Finds stored authentication information for a request.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoFindAuthInfo2
methods.description: Finds stored authentication info with optional parent URI indication.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoSetAcmIf
methods.description: Sets the Access Control Module Interface.

methods.name: HttpAuthcoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the HTTP auth client.
